generationMethod: Built-in image_gen.imagegen, individual asset calls; no AI video

generations.reason: Original layer too large for hull/mast.

packaging: Whole-asset mechanical crop with 14 px margin (except same-canvas hull/sail), lossless WebP; generated alpha retained. No non-generative art edits.

visualChecks.background: Spacious continuous water and far harbor at eye level; no people or text or foreground interactive boats.
visualChecks.ferry: Complete connected two-deck ferry, bow right, windows/life rings, no cropped mast/hull.
visualChecks.sailboat: Bare rigging/hull plus separate fabric layer registration privately inspected on blue. Full mast/boom/hull, restrained rigid wind movement intended.
visualChecks.fishingboat: Complete hull/cabin/net/baskets, bow right, no people or animal faces.
visualChecks.lighthouse: Complete lantern/tower/stone footing, light anchor recorded.
visualChecks.buoy: One complete red navigational buoy with cone topmark, cage and float base.
visualChecks.pier: Complete timber deck and piles, genuine transparent gaps, no opaque water rectangle.
visualChecks.alpha: All object source images have actual transparency, ≥53.9% fully transparent pixels; no alpha≥16 at the source edge. Soft interior alpha near253 is generated, preserved.
